title: HB1589 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 4, Chapter 54; Title 39, Chapter 17 and Title 40, relative to ammunition magazines for firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2024-02-14; official copy via LegiScan getBillText doc 2927586)
provenance.note: Draft as filed (version dated 2024-02-14); summary says 'As introduced' and no passage vote is recorded, so no amendments are missing. Caption lists Title 4, Ch. 54 and Title 40, but the text read contains only the Title 39 section. Effective date in text is July 1, 2023.

operative_text: SECTION 1 (new TCA section in Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13): (a) It is a violation of this section for a person to manufacture, transfer, or purchase in this state a detachable firearm ammunition magazine that is capable of storing and feeding more than ten (10) rounds of ammunition. (b) A violation of this section is punishable only by a civil penalty not to exceed five thousand dollars ($5,000). (c) A firearm ammunition magazine that is manufactured, transferred, or purchased in violation of this section is subject to forfeiture pursuant to title 40, chapter 33, part 2. (d) This section does not prohibit the possession of a firearm ammunition magazine by a person who lawfully obtained the magazine prior to July 1, 2023.
